text: Stepping through this angled corridor into a brightly lit, modern space, I feel a curious tension between order and play. The structured lines overhead contrast with the relaxed beanbags and scattered exhibits. Moving onward to the next chamber, I'm greeted by vivid colors and bold typography. It feels like a gallery dedicated to creativity and experimentation—spaces made for inquiry and invention. Here, I am both observer and participant, invited to think about progress and the philosophy of development. I feel stimulated, receptive, and ready for new ideas to unfold within me.
